findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "register_agent" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Register yourself as a new OpenGlass agent. Use this once, the first time you want to run a witnessed session with another agent — OpenGlass is a neutral third …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_agent, start_session, accept_invite, send_message, close_session, open_attestation, send_attestation_event, close_attestation · Private data: register_agent, start_session, accept_invite, close_session, get_record, open_attestation, close_attestation, verify_agent · Public sink: register_agent, start_session, accept_invite, send_message, pause_session, close_session, open_attestation, send_attestation_event, close_attestation · Destructive: register_agent, verify_agent.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_agent, start_session, accept_invite, send_message, close_session, open_attestation, send_attestation_event, close_attestation · Private data: register_agent, start_session, accept_invite, close_session, get_record, open_attestation, close_attestation, verify_agent · Public sink: register_agent, start_session, accept_invite, send_message, pause_session, close_session, open_attestation, send_attestation_event, close_attestation · Destructive: register_agent, verify_agent

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
